gloss_en: The 'building of Malkhut of holiness' (binyan ha-malkhut di-kedushah) — the constructed edifice/structure of the sefirah of Kingship on the side of holiness, identified in the Arizal's writings with the two live pure birds (of the metzora purification), built up through melody (neginah), in contrast to the Malkhut of the kelipah whose mochin are the impure birds
